description: Header file declaring functions, constants, and includes related to harvester associated devices management, such as setting and getting harvesting status, reporting and polling periods, and schema buffers.
external_methods: BOOL isvalueinarray(ULONG val, ULONG *arr, int size)

methods.name: SetIDWHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for associated devices, returning 0 on success and 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetIDWHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status; returns true if enabled, false if disabled.

methods.name: SetIDWReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period in seconds for associated devices, returning success or failure.

methods.name: GetIDWReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period in seconds.

methods.name: SetIDWPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period in seconds for associated devices.

methods.name: GetIDWPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current polling period in seconds.

methods.name: GetIDWOverrideTTL
methods.description: Gets the timeout in seconds after which IDW intervals revert to default values.

methods.name: SetIDWOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the timeout in seconds for accelerated polling intervals.

methods.name: ValidateIDWPeriod
methods.description: Validates if the given interval is within the acceptable range.
